crons._comment: War-room watchdog — 60s recovery/expire/timeout scan. Per WAR_ROOM_DESIGN.md L954-958, the design specifies 60s tick interval (1 minute). Per-installation cron entries: duplicate this entry with a different `installationId` query param when adding a second installation. Until per-installation entries are wired up, this single entry uses INSTALLATION_ID env-var substitution at deploy time (see deploy notes in apiary/run-hivemoot-docker.sh) — replaced before vercel.json is uploaded.
